text:
jordan: heads-up - we're seeing ambiguous billing hits when customers create API keys during onboarding. proposal: default new keys to project-scoped, surface 'effective project' in console, and require explicit "Make Org Key" checkbox for org-scope.

maya: totally +1. quick UX thought  show a tiny pill with `proj:<id>` or `org` in the keys list and a tooltip explaining quota/billing consequences. also add a migration button that runs a simulation for last 30d.

shiv: routing semantics to confirm: precedence should be (1) explicit key.project, (2) hint header `X-Redwood-Project-Hint`, (3) org scope if key marked org, (4) fallback to legacy org-behavior. If ambiguous and org is on strict mode, reject with 401.

jordan: agree. telemetry: we need two new access-log columns `effective_project` and `declared_scope` and a diagnostic event `auth.routing_conflict` when hint and key.project disagree. we'll need to backfill so we can estimate billing delta.

maya: for dashboards I'll mock a panel: `requests by effective_project` and `org-key inferred breakdown`. add a simulation graph that shows token-cost delta if migrated. will post mocks later today. :bar_chart:

shiv: quotas: keep org-scoped keys on org quota bucket for now. console should surface both the org quota and per-project estimated consumption under simulation. long term offer "auto-split" option which attributes requests using the hint header.

jordan: rollout plan: (a) add metadata + console pill, (b) emit telemetry fields and a weekly backfill job, (c) FF canary for new-key default = project, (d) migration UI for org-admins. canary only on support opt-in orgs.

maya: monitoring: add a Prometheus alert `Auth:EffectiveProjectShift` when >20% of traffic migrates projects within 1h. also alert on sudden quota mismatches.

deploy-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-1402 "auth: project-default keys + telemetry + migration simulation" and linked this thread.

jordan: action items: @shiv write RFC for routing precedence and quota semantics, @maya produce dashboard mocks and sample Grafana queries, i'll own migration UX + console copy. target: RFC + mocks in 8 days.

shiv: one edgecase - webhooks and background workers often reuse org keys. include a diagnostic `auth.migration_candidate` when an org-key maps to a single project >=95% of traffic for 7d. that'll help surface low-risk migration candidates.

maya: adding that to the dashboard mock. also will include sample SDK header for future auto-split: ```
X-Redwood-Project-Hint: proj-0001
X-Redwood-Client: go-sdk/0.9.1
```

jordan: good. final note: add a small confirmation modal when converting an org-key to project to show estimated billing delta and affected projects.

deploy-bot: INF-1402 updated: assignees jordan, shiv, maya; due_date set to 7 days.

jordan: thanks all. keeping canary small and documented. :rocket:
